'''Jethro''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is a mechanic and is usually seen with best friend [[Dwaine]]. He is voiced by [[John Zurhellen]], who also voices [[Jeremy St. Ives]] in [[Grand Theft Auto IV]], [[The Lost and Damned]] and [[The Ballad of Gay Tony]].

==Character history==
Jethro, at some point prior to [[1986]], had become a skilled mechanic working on marine engines along side best friend [[Dwaine]] at their [[Boatyard|boatyard]] in [[Viceport]], [[Vice City in GTA III Era|Vice City]]. The two, seemingly comfortable in Vice City, sell their business to [[Vercetti Gang|mob]] [[Gang Leaders|boss]] [[Tommy Vercetti]]. The two, prior to [[1989]], leave Vice City after they could no longer return to the boatyard and settled down in [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]]. The two attend the '89 Fierro Love In, located in [[San Fierro]], where they met [[The Truth]], an aging hippie who began selling them drugs from his farm in [[Leafy Hollow]].

Jethro had got a job at the [[Xoomer|Xoomer Gas Station]] in [[Easter Basin]], working as a mechanic, but is convinced by The Truth to join protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] at his [[Doherty Garage|garage]], later being joined there by Dwayne. He continues to appear at Carl's garage, initially seen to be [[Deconstruction|working on a car]], telling Carl that two [[Frank Tenpenny|police]] [[Eddie Pulaski|officers]] have come looking for him, [[Zeroing In|playing cards]] with Carl and [[Cesar Vialpando]], [[Test Drive|looking at a car]] and [[Puncture Wounds|sitting at a table]] with Carl. Jethro also informs Carl of the local [[Driving School|driving school]], suggesting his driving could be [[Back to School|improved]] and later of the illegal street racing scene in San Fierro.

==Trivia==
*An unused audio file in [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] suggested that Jethro and Dwaine were also to appear in [[The Fastest Boat]] for [[Ricardo Diaz]].
